text:
Three methods to demagnetise a magnet are suggested. The magnet is in an east-west direction.
1
hitting the magnet repeatedly with a hammer
2
heating the magnet until red hot
3
withdrawing the magnet from a coil which has a direct current (d.c.) in it
Which methods demagnetise the magnet?
A
1, 2 and 3
B
1 and 2 only
C
1 and 3 only
D
2 and 3 only
subject: Physics
